subject: ant-mimicking spider
title: This Spider Fakes Being an Ant by Waving Two Legs as Antennae

scenes.text: This spider stays alive by pretending it isn't a spider.
Many hunters would rather eat a spider than an ant, which bites and stings.
So this jumping spider has a narrow, ant-shaped body. But looks alone aren't enough.
It walks in winding zigzags, like an ant following a scent trail.
And when it stops, it lifts its two front legs and waves them like antennae.
In tests, predators attacked it about as rarely as real ants. An ant with eight legs.

description:
An ant-mimicking jumping spider survives by walking like an ant and raising its front legs like antennae.
A Cornell study in Proceedings of the Royal Society B found predatory jumping spiders attacked the mimics about as often as real ants, and far less than ordinary jumping spiders.
Would you have spotted that it was a spider?
first_comment: Its pauses last only about a tenth of a second, too quick for many predators' eyes to catch. Have you ever seen one of these?
